note: TOC Filter provides a text-format filter plugin 'toc_filter' ("Display a table of contents") that replaces a [toc] token with a hierarchical TOC built from header tags, delegating rendering to the TOC API module. Filter config lives in filter.format.<id> under filters.toc_filter with settings type (a toc_type id), auto ('' | top | bottom), block (bool), exclude_above (bool). It also ships a 'Table of contents' block (id toc_filter) and invites hook_toc_filter_alter(). configure route entity.toc_type.list is owned by TOC API (Structure > Table of contents). Medium cases read filter settings off a live format; hard cases require enabling the filter / setting its options, verified against filter.format config. No permissions, no Drush, has a config schema.

evals.prompt: Using the TOC Filter module, how does an editor place a table of contents in a node body, and how can they override the TOC style or set a heading for a single placement?
evals.expected_output: Add a [toc] token in the body where the TOC should appear (the format must have the 'Display a table of contents' filter enabled). Inline options are attributes on the token, e.g. [toc type="simple" title="On this page"] to override the TOC type and set the heading. Only the first [toc] token is replaced.

evals.prompt: What settings does the TOC Filter's text-format filter expose, and which module actually renders the table of contents?
evals.expected_output: The toc_filter filter has four settings: type (which TOC type/style), auto ('' | top | bottom, auto-insert a TOC when no [toc] token is present), block (render via the 'Table of contents' block instead of inline), and exclude_above (ignore headers above the token). Rendering is delegated to the TOC API module (toc_api.manager / toc_api.builder), which also owns the TOC types.

evals.prompt: With TOC Filter, how do I show the table of contents in a sidebar block instead of inline in the content, and how do I make a text format add a TOC automatically without editors typing a token?
evals.expected_output: Set the filter's 'block' setting to true (or use [toc block="true"]) and place the 'Table of contents' block (plugin id toc_filter) in a region. To auto-add a TOC, set the filter's 'auto' setting to top or bottom, which injects a [toc] token when none is present.

evals.prompt: This site has a text format named 'TOC Filter Med' (machine name toc_filter_med) with the TOC filter enabled. Inspect the live filter configuration and state the value of the TOC filter's 'auto' setting on that format.
evals.expected_output: The 'auto' setting is 'bottom' - in filter.format.toc_filter_med, filters.toc_filter.settings.auto = bottom, so a TOC is auto-inserted at the bottom of content when no [toc] token is present.

evals.prompt: On this site the text format 'TOC Filter Med2' (machine name toc_filter_med2) has the TOC filter enabled. Inspect the live configuration and report which TOC type the filter is configured to use.
evals.expected_output: The filter uses the 'simple' TOC type - filter.format.toc_filter_med2, filters.toc_filter.settings.type = simple.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format 'TOC Filter Hard' (machine name toc_filter_hard) that does NOT yet have the TOC filter enabled. Enable the 'Display a table of contents' (toc_filter) filter on that format. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The toc_filter filter is enabled on filter.format.toc_filter_hard (filters.toc_filter.status = true), e.g. via the format's Text formats and editors settings or FilterFormat::setFilterConfig('toc_filter', ['status' => TRUE, ...])->save().

evals.prompt: On this site the text format 'TOC Filter Hard2' (machine name toc_filter_hard2) already has the table-of-contents filter turned on, but a TOC only appears when an editor adds the token. Change the setup so that every piece of content using this format automatically gets a table of contents at the TOP, without editors having to add anything. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the toc_filter filter's 'auto' setting to 'top' on filter.format.toc_filter_hard2 (filters.toc_filter.settings.auto = top), so a [toc] is auto-inserted at the top when no token is present.
